baseline.head: 41c000fb98fdd42ab6f3f9f486f531eafcb520e2
baseline.subject: Stage 9.3a: complete user and public documentation

repository_audit.prior_policy: Stage 9.1a recommends, but does not prove, a Pandoc wrapper with explicit XeLaTeX and known fonts.
repository_audit.runtime_isolation_evidence: Clean-install and distribution validators assert that reportlab, weasyprint and fpdf are absent from runtime-only installations.

proposed_architecture.orchestrator: Repository standard-library Python wrapper with fixed document mappings
proposed_architecture.renderer: Version-checked Pandoc with explicit XeLaTeX engine, committed defaults/template material and declared TeX fonts
proposed_architecture.inspection: Independent Poppler pdfinfo, pdftotext, pdffonts and pdftoppm commands
proposed_architecture.dependency_declaration: Separate repository documentation-toolchain declaration and instructions; no project runtime dependency or ordinary user requirement
proposed_architecture.reproducibility: Two clean temporary builds per source with fixed locale/timezone/SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH/toolchain; require byte-identical SHA-256
proposed_architecture.timestamp: After successful validation, set PDF st_mtime_ns to source st_mtime_ns with os.utime and verify equality
proposed_architecture.manifest: Exactly two LF-terminated '<sha256><two spaces><basename>' lines, Markdown first and PDF second
proposed_architecture.ci: No v1.1.0 CI change; complete local generation and validation is mandatory

established_requirements: Markdown is authoritative and PDFs are generated artifacts.
Both PDFs and both per-guide manifests are committed.
Each manifest hashes its Markdown and PDF.
Each PDF mtime is synchronized to its Markdown source.
Rendered visual and non-OCR content validation are required.
Only PDFs later enter the release ZIP; Stage 9.4 owns ZIP assembly and its external checksum.
approval_required: Independent acceptance of the Checkpoint A specification and architecture
Acceptance of the separate development-toolchain declaration
Acceptance of Pandoc/XeLaTeX rendering and Poppler inspection
Acceptance of strict two-build byte equality
Acceptance of the exact manifest format and visual/content gates
Explicit authorisation to begin Checkpoint B
